messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary anomaly detected for model 'redwood-xl:v4.2.1' in region us-west. Tokenizer parse-errors spiked to 12% on /v1/generate (threshold 3%). Observability: increased user-visible truncation and JSON parse failures. Paging eng-oncall @alex.

alex: taking this. I'm seeing the same in the dashboard (errors, parsing failures). Can folks avoid manual rollouts/changes in the next 10m while we diagnose?

priya: on it. Quick note: v4.2.1 pulled yesterday included a tokenizer tweak for whitespace-sep tokens; could be related. I'll pull canary logs.

jamie: incident-bot created INC-2026-1023 and set Sev=2 due to customer impact on a subset of production traffic. Noted affected product routes: /v1/generate-chat and /v1/completions for customers on dedicated capacity.

Maya: CS: two customers (AcmeCo, EduWave) reported garbled JSON outputs in the last 8 minutes, they're seeing downstream parsing errors. I opened priority support threads and notified their engineering leads.

priya: logs snippet from canary pods (us-west):
```
ERROR parse_tokenizer: unexpected token at byte 1024
ERROR generation_output: returned invalid JSON, truncated field 'choices[0].message'
```
Suspect mismatch between tokenization table and runtime tokenizer config. Checking weightset metadata and tokenizer hash.

infra-bot: Canary rollout metadata: image=redwood-inference:release-2026-04-11, model=redwood-xl:v4.2.1, tokenizer_hash=0x7a9b, deployed_by=ci-pipeline-42, canary_traffic=5%.

alex: good context. Two immediate mitigation options: 1) flip kill-switch to stop routing traffic to v4.2.1 canary, 2) rollback traffic to redwood-xl:v4.1.9 or route affected customers to fallback model. Which do we prefer?

priya: preference is kill-switch + route to fallback v4.1.9 for minimal change. Rolling weights rollback could be slower if cache priming needed. I can flip the tokenizer feature flag if needed. Flag id: flags.model.tokenizer.v4_2_1.disable=true.

jamie: I'll coordinate kill-switch. Executing feature-flag flip and routing change now.

jamie: ACTION: flipping flag via console:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  https://flags.redwood/api/flags/model.tokenizer.v4_2_1.disable -d '{"value":true}'
```

jamie: ACTION: routing change to fallback model for canary group:
```
redwoodctl route update --from-model redwood-xl:v4.2.1 --to-model redwood-xl:v4.1.9 --selector canary=true
```

infra-bot: feature flag update acknowledged, routing update submitted. Rolling update request id=route-98765.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic kill confirmed. v4.2.1 canary traffic reduced from 5% -> 0% over 35s. Metric: tokenizer parse-errors dropped to baseline ~0.8% in us-west.

Maya: Reached out to AcmeCo and EduWave with mitigation status and ETA. Both confirm they see improvement on their test calls. Tracking case numbers CS-3421, CS-3422.

alex: great. Next steps: collect failing payloads and a deterministic repro. Priya, please capture the tokenizer hash mismatch and checklist of release artifacts. Jamie, please keep the kill-switch and route in place until we validate a fixed build.

priya: I pulled the artifact metadata: v4.2.1 tokenizer_hash in the weight-bundle manifest = 0x7a9b but runtime tokenizer binary reports 0x7a8f on some nodes — looks like deployment path inconsistency (some hosts got an older tokenizer binary). Likely a packaging race in the CI artifact promotion. Preparing a rebuild with consistent hash.

alex: root cause hypothesis: packaging race caused a mismatched tokenizer binary to be pushed to a subset of nodes during the canary rollout. Impact: parsing errors for ~2.3% of total customer requests in us-west during window. No data exfiltration. SLOs: user error budget for parsing exceeded briefly for the affected routes.

jamie: I will open a rollback-postmortem ticket and schedule oncall follow-up. For customers affected, CS has the remediation notes and ticket links.

incident-bot: Timeline created in INC-2026-1023: 2193456789 alert -> 2193456832 kill-switch flip -> 2193456890 routing change confirmed -> 2193456960 parse-errors returning to baseline.

alex: Accepting handoff. Priya, can you confirm rebuild and tests? If green, we'll redeploy v4.2.1 with corrected tokenizer binary and run an extended internal canary (0.5%) before scaling.

priya: Rebuild in progress, unit/regression tests include tokenizer hash assert and end-to-end schema checks. ETA ~25m. I'll post logs and CI artifact digest once ready.

Maya: Notified impacted customers that we will validate and redeploy only after additional checks. Offer extended support window.

jamie: Postmortem owners: priya (cause & fixes), alex (oncall ops timeline), maya (customer comms). I'll create the postmortem doc and assign follow-ups.

alex: Thanks team. Keeping thread open for verification. If parse-errors stay low for next 30m and CI build passes, we'll plan controlled redeploy.

priya: CI artifacts done: tokenizer_hash=0x7a9b, manifest and runtime match. Running e2e canary in staging.

jamie: staging canary green at 30 minutes. Approval to start rolling deploy to canary nodes with corrected artifact. Proceeding with gradual canary (0.5% -> 2% -> 5%).

infra-bot: Rolling deploy started, rollout id=roll-3344. Monitoring: token-parse errors metric subscription added to the incident.

deploy-bot: New canary with corrected tokenizer shows parse-errors <= 0.5%. No customer reports in last 45m.

alex: closing active mitigation. Keeping incident open for postmortem tracking. Good work.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1023 severity reduced to S2 -> S3. Postmortem template link: https://docs.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-1023/postmortem

jamie: Follow-ups: add tokenizer hash check to release pipeline, add canary routing safety timeout, update runbook to include feature-flag kill-switch steps. Assigning tasks in tracker.

Maya: CS follow-ups scheduled with affected customers; will share final communication after the postmortem.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll update the #oncall-log and hand this off to priya for root-cause write-up.

priya: taking postmortem ownership. I'll post a draft in the postmortem doc in the next 24h.

jamie: closing thread for active paging. We'll reconvene if metrics regress. :white_check_mark:
